items.name: tokens
items.title: MetalUI tokens
items.description: Soft Hardware colorways (bone, graphite), materials, caps and springs as --mu-* custom properties. Every component imports it.

items.name: block-silhouette
items.title: Block silhouette
items.description: A block seen from far away: below the far-zoom threshold the canvas draws one flat, cheap shape per block that still says its kind (text bars, a dark code card, a link's tinted glass, a colour, a light file plate, a region's tray and name).
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/block-silhouette.md. SwiftUI: MetalBlockSilhouette in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: brush-cursor
items.title: Brush cursor
items.description: The pointer while drawing or erasing: a disc in the ink colour at the stroke width times the zoom, or a dashed ring the size of what the eraser removes; it follows the pointer in the same frame.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/brush-cursor.md. SwiftUI: MetalBrushCursor in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A press-in pill button. It sinks 1px into a well while held and springs back on release: standard, primary and destructive caps at 32 or compact 26, and the link, graphite and strip caps. Tailwind v4 utilities from the theme.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/button.md. SwiftUI: MetalButton in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: The dimple checkbox: a recessed well that turns into a dark pressed key with a drawn tick; doing (half green) and ghost (an inferred task's hollow ring) states.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/checkbox.md. SwiftUI: MetalCheckbox in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: A small pill with an optional leading LED or glyph and trailing actions: suggestion, glass, glass-action and tag.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/chip.md. SwiftUI: MetalChip in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: code-card
items.title: Code card
items.description: Code as a glass object: numbered, tinted lines (at most 18) on a dark screen under a CODE · LANG · N LINES tag.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/code-card.md. SwiftUI: MetalCodeCard in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command palette
items.description: ⌘K: a 560 frost plate with a 44 field well, sections of 36 rows with matches marked, a raised selected row with a green bar, destructive rows in red, and a footer of keycaps. Hover moves the selection; ↩ runs, ⇧↩ pins. Built on Base UI Dialog and an inline Combobox.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/command-palette.md. SwiftUI: MetalCommandPalette, MetalCommandPaletteItem in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: connector
items.title: Connector
items.description: The look around ink that joins two blocks: a green halo and end dots on hover (solid attached, hollow free), end handles when selected, and a label chip at the middle; same size on screen at every zoom.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/connector.md. SwiftUI: MetalConnector in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal layer: a scrim behind a surface; focus stays inside, Escape and a click outside close it.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/dialog.md. SwiftUI: MetalDialog in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: draw-picks
items.title: Draw picks
items.description: The ink and width choices in the drawing group: five glossy ink beads and three width dots in the current ink; the chosen one sits in a sunk well like a latched tool.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/draw-picks.md. SwiftUI: MetalDrawPicks in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: draw-tools
items.title: Draw tools
items.description: The drawing group of the toolbar: eight tool caps (pen, pencil, marker, line, arrow, rectangle, ellipse, eraser) with one latched, then the five inks and three widths.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/draw-tools.md. SwiftUI: MetalDrawTools in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Text input in a well with a leading glyph and trailing keycaps; SearchField, a button in a well that opens search.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/field.md. SwiftUI: MetalField, MetalSearchField in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: filter-bar
items.title: Filter bar
items.description: Names the question a filter asks and switches how the answer is shown: Surface(frost) with a Glyph, the query in Label(query), the count and source engraved, a compact Segmented of views, and IconButton(ghost) pin and close. Formerly LensBar.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/filter-bar.md. SwiftUI: MetalFilterBar in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: folder
items.title: Folder
items.description: A folder on the canvas that holds blocks: a back panel with a tab, up to three blocks peeking up as cards, a frosted flap with its name and count; fans on hover, opens wide when a block is dragged over, swings shut when one lands; six paper colours.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/folder.md. SwiftUI: MetalFolder in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: glass-face
items.title: Glass face
items.description: A dark glass object: a bezel around a screen with a glare, a shaded rim and an inner shadow.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/glass-face.md. SwiftUI: MetalGlassFace in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: glyph
items.title: Glyph
items.description: A static icon at a size (10, 14, 16) in an ink (ink, ink2, ink3, inherit); decorative.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/glyph.md. SwiftUI: MetalGlyph in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: hover-engraving
items.title: Hover engraving
items.description: A block's identity on a 420 ms dwell: Surface(tip) beside its first line with the kind and details in Label(engraved), derived tags as Chip(tag) and the recognizer's status with a Led.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/hover-engraving.md. SwiftUI: MetalHoverEngraving in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: icon-button
items.title: Icon button
items.description: A pressable cap with only a glyph: tool (a graphite cap that latches with a green LED), ghost (flat, round) and mini (inside a chip).
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/icon-button.md. SwiftUI: MetalIconButton in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Keycap
items.description: A key's glyph on a small raised cap, in the readout role: 20 tall (16 in a footer), on a light surface, a graphite strip, or sunk into a toast's Undo.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/kbd.md. SwiftUI: MetalKbd in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Text in a set role: engraved, small, title, heading, query, count, cell, value, display, readout, on-graphite and dark; as="input" edits in place.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/label.md. SwiftUI: MetalLabel in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: lasso
items.title: Lasso
items.description: The box a drag on empty canvas draws: a 1 pt intent-green hairline over a faint fill, and a graphite readout under it counting what it will select (● 3 blocks). The same on screen at every zoom.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/lasso.md. SwiftUI: MetalLasso in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: line-handles
items.title: Line handles
items.description: The presence of a drawn line or arrow: a green halo and end dots on hover, two end handles when selected; the connector's selection language.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/line-handles.md. SwiftUI: MetalLineHandles in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: link-card
items.title: Link card
items.description: A link as a glass object: the host and path on a screen tinted by the host, a LINK tag and one OPEN ↗ action.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/link-card.md. SwiftUI: MetalLinkCard in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: mark
items.title: Mark
items.description: Inline, metric-neutral text marks: dated and quiet underlines, a tag pill, a derived-tag ring, a hex underline with its swatch, a URL host pill, an inferred pill, the urgency LED and a trailing glyph.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/mark.md. SwiftUI: MetalMark, MetalMarkURLPill, MetalMarkInferred, MetalMarkUrgency, MetalMarkLife, Text.metalMark(_:) in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu and correction popover
items.description: A frosted plate of 30 rows (frost-strong at .92, radius 18, padding 6, at least 200 wide) from a trigger or at the pointer: an engraved heading says what it acts on, pointer and keyboard share one highlight, keys at the right, destructive rows red, engraved separators; fades on settle. The correction popover is its right-click form. Built on Base UI Menu and Context Menu.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/menu.md. SwiftUI: MetalMenuPanel, MetalMenuItem, View.metalMenu(isPresented:at:heading:items:) in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: past-banner
items.title: Past banner
items.description: The only chrome that changes while the canvas is scrubbed into the past: Surface(graphite-plain) with the MEMORY engraving, the moment viewed, and a Back to Now cap with its key.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/past-banner.md. SwiftUI: MetalPastBanner in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: perfect-preview
items.title: Perfect preview
items.description: Hold to perfect: while the pen is held still after a rough stroke, the fitted clean shape draws itself round as a faint green outline over 450 ms; when it closes the host morphs the stroke into the shape.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/perfect-preview.md. SwiftUI: MetalPerfectPreview in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: provenance-tooltip
items.title: Provenance tooltip
items.description: One hover away from every cue: a wrapped Tooltip that says where the cue came from (Rule · date parser, Recognizer · 0.82, You), the detail in Tooltip.Dim, with the number whenever the app guessed.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/provenance-tooltip.md. SwiftUI: MetalProvenanceTooltip, .metalProvenance(_:detail:) in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: region
items.title: Region
items.description: A drawn rectangle with a name that carries a rule: Well(region) with a head (Label name, Label rule, Label count) that lights as a drop target, dims, hides in the past and renames in place; a pinned lens is Surface(lens) with Row(list) rows.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/region.md. SwiftUI: MetalRegion, MetalRegionRow in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: row
items.title: Row
items.description: A row in a list: list, panel and option (the active one raises with a green rail); checked rows strike their text.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/row.md. SwiftUI: MetalRow in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: rule
items.title: Rule
items.description: An engraved groove between groups; graphite on dark chrome.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/rule.md. SwiftUI: MetalRule in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: segmented
items.title: Segmented control
items.description: A pill of pills on Base UI RadioGroup: a well track, segments on the height ladder, and a raised thumb that glides to the selection on the part spring.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/segmented.md. SwiftUI: MetalSegmented in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: One value from a list of named options: a raised cap showing the value and an up-down chevron, opening the menu's frosted list with the chosen row over the trigger; the chosen row carries the latched green LED.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/select.md. SwiftUI: MetalSelect in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: selection-frame
items.title: Selection frame
items.description: The one selection for every kind of object: a 1.25 green ring with a flat collar at offset 6, eight handles on the ring line, and a graphite readout of the measured frame. Hover shows only faint corner dots and an edge light.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/selection-frame.md. SwiftUI: MetalSelectionFrame in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: settings
items.title: Settings
items.description: An app's settings as sections of rows: an engraved heading over a raised card; each row a name, an optional detail and one control on the right; engraved rules between rows; shortcut rows with keycaps.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/settings.md. SwiftUI: MetalSettings in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: size-readout
items.title: Size readout
items.description: A graphite pill that reads a measured value: an object's size, a multi-selection's count, a copy, a zoom level. Surface(graphite-deep) with a live Led and the value in Label(readout).
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/size-readout.md. SwiftUI: MetalSizeReadout in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A track well, a green fill up to a knurled knob, tick marks and labelled ticks; arrows step, Shift steps large.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/slider.md. SwiftUI: MetalSlider in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: snap-guides
items.title: Snap guides
items.description: The lines that explain a snap while a person moves or resizes on the canvas: 1 pt intent green, solid for aligned edges, dashed for aligned centres, spanning the aligned objects plus 8 pt, the same on screen at every zoom.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/snap-guides.md. SwiftUI: MetalSnapGuides in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: sparkline
items.title: Sparkline
items.description: A small series plot: a line with gaps, dots, the last point emphasised, a dashed baseline at the average.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/sparkline.md. SwiftUI: MetalSparkline in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: status
items.title: LED and status badge
items.description: A 4–5 pt LED lit from the top left (green live, amber waiting, red failed, blue link, off), and the 24 tall status badge: an LED and the state in the label role, not pressable, with the fixing command as a tooltip.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/status.md. SwiftUI: MetalLED, MetalStatusBadge in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: suggestion-chip
items.title: Suggestion chip
items.description: One question the recognizer asks at middle confidence, beside its block: Chip(suggestion) with the question, its confidence as a small engraving, and mini accept and dismiss buttons. Faint until the block is hovered.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/suggestion-chip.md. SwiftUI: MetalSuggestionChip in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: surface
items.title: Surface
items.description: A raised plate or card from a material recipe: raise, raise-lite, raise-sm, frost, plate, panel, pop, tip, lens and the graphites.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/surface.md. SwiftUI: MetalSurface in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A setting that is on or off and takes effect at once: a sunk pill track with a raised thumb that slides on the part spring; on, the track fills soft green.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/switch.md. SwiftUI: MetalSwitch in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switches which panel is shown: the segmented track and gliding thumb as the tab list, and panels that drift in from the side the thumb went.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/tabs.md. SwiftUI: MetalTabs in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: time-scrubber
items.title: Time scrubber
items.description: Time as a dimension of the surface: a Slider (track, moment marks, day ticks, knurled knob) under an engraved readout with NOW as Button(link) while in the past. Formerly MemoryScrubber.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/time-scrubber.md. SwiftUI: MetalTimeScrubber in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: The result of a person's own action, with Undo: a 44 tall smoked pill at the bottom centre, one at a time, arriving on settle and leaving on release. Built on Base UI Toast.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/toast.md. SwiftUI: MetalToast, .metalToast(_:) in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: tool-strip
items.title: Tool strip
items.description: Verbs over a click selection: Surface(graphite-strip) with Button(strip) caps (Tasks, Summarise, Gather, Region, Export) and Send away as Button(strip-danger) after a Rule. Rises 4 on the part spring.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/tool-strip.md. SwiftUI: MetalToolStrip in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar and tool button
items.description: A frosted capsule strip of circular 36 tool caps (frost in the colorway, or graphite), latched tools pressed with a green LED, engraved separators, a search well, and tooltips with the key. Built on Base UI Toolbar, Toggle and Tooltip.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/toolbar.md. SwiftUI: MetalToolbar, MetalToolButton, MetalToolbarSeparator in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Names an icon-only control and its key: a graphite pill chip in the label role, SELECT · V with the key dimmed, 10 from the trigger after 120 ms, grouped so the next trigger shows at once; flips near the edge; fades on settle. Built on Base UI Tooltip. wrap makes a longer note that wraps at 280 with its detail in Tooltip.Dim.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/tooltip.md. SwiftUI: View.metalTooltip(_:shortcut:edge:) in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: well
items.title: Well
items.description: A sunk field or track: field, track, region (with a drop-target state) and graphite.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/well.md. SwiftUI: MetalWell in the MetalUI Swift package.
